notes.title: Spectacular Sparky Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
- The SUPERNORMAL difficulty setting has been rebalanced and now has a small amount of dynamic difficulty based on how you play
- Fixed an issue where the screen didn’t resume scrolling after some battles on ultrawide monitors
- Fixed an issue where, in some localizations, dialogue would get stuck and not resume, or would pause for too long, especially in the Melon Head and Dr. Votsit fights
- fixed known issues related to Xbox 360 controllers
- Fixed known issues on high refresh rate monitors
- Fixed some issues with missing text in some localizations
- Fixed line break issues in the Japanese localization, along with other improvements to it
- additional minor bug fixes

notes.title: Blaster Basics
notes.content:
The release of Spectacular Sparky is just one day away! What better time to brush up on your bounty-hunting blaster skills?

As Sparky knows all too well, [i]most[/i] problems can be solved with a reckless hail of gunfire. But you'll sometimes find yourself in situations where a bit more precision is needed to reduce your foes to cinders. Luckily there's the Aim Lock button for just such an occasion! Hold it down to lock Sparky's current blaster angle, allowing him to fire in one direction while moving around in any direction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047987/abd7191b90e47bbb3e2e1696a95a28432a675107.gif[/img]

But what about those times when pesky space creeps are coming at you from all sides? That's when the Aim button is your best bet! Hold it to anchor Sparky in place, aim in any direction you want, and blast away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047987/161b203a1cf3336cac0490a5e4cbb1f5ff991c80.gif[/img]

And don't forget that Sparky's highly-versatile blaster can utilize a wide range of ammo pickups, including lasers, flames, and even homing missiles - plus it can hold two ammo types at a time, which you can swap between at any moment! Watch that heat meter though - if you go trigger-happy for too long, you'll burn out your currently equipped special ammo, returning it to the standard blaster mode.

Get those trigger fingers ready, because Spectacular Sparky, the action-packed 16-bit throwback you've been waiting for, launches TOMORROW!

notes.title: Spectacular Space Combat!
notes.content:
It's not intergalactic bounty hunting if there isn't a little intergalactic space travel involved. Often when Sparky receives a new mission from Shigg, the journey to the alien planet is just as dangerous as the bounties themselves. Luckily, Sparky has a state-of-the-art starship.. that just happens to be shaped like his own head! Equipped with dual blasters, it's perfect for tearing a path through whatever floating space miscreants he may come across.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047987/01f6e962b88adb0aa0bd23847deb73c6f0b0df61.gif[/img]

But it's not all slimeballs and space bees out there, Sparky is bound to run into some particularly nasty celestial boss creatures too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047987/2eba143999d510680ebf35707c27e3c7b51e8a6f.gif[/img]

For more deep space adventures, remember to wishlist Spectacular Sparky, coming to Steam on October 20th! And give the demo as spin today, available now as a part of the Steam Next Fest!

notes.title: A Spectacular Boss Battle Preview!
notes.content:
Spectacular Sparky features no fewer than 24 bombastic boss battles, with a whole host of deranged galactic outlaws just waiting to have their chops busted and their bounties claimed! But did you also know the game features dozens of story scenes with full voice acting? Sparky, the maniacal little scamp that he is, delights in meeting and mocking his foes before blasting them into space chunks!

Check out this boss intro and boss battle preview, featuring the hilarious voice acting talents of Sebastian Todd as Sparky, and Sean Barrett as Sgt. Blownaparte - a grizzled veteran of the Gene War who had most of his body destroyed in a grenade blast, rebuilt himself using weaponized mechanical parts, and has had a number of screws loose ever since!

[previewyoutube=AtLpanL2NeI;full][/previewyoutube]

Spectacular Sparky releases later this year on October 20th! Keep watching this space for more explosive preview content, and be sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: Say Hello to Spectacular Sparky!
notes.content:
In Spectacular Sparky, you play as… yeah, you guessed it, Sparky! He may look like an adorable space rabbit, but he’s actually a maniacal, destruction-loving bounty hunter with unknown origins. Equipped with a highly versatile blaster, the ability to jump multiple times and a crazy dash to get out of danger, Sparky is capable of much more than meets the eye! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047987/af06db7283a8e06eb255c4beaebcfca919445c0a.png[/img]

Sparky doesn’t work alone, though. To direct his bounty-hunting activities, he relies on his friend Shigg, a half shark, half pig with a military background. Shigg helps direct the mercurial Sparky toward the right bad guys while also providing some helpful intel in preparation for taking down each target. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047987/52d69bd6a2e1d15ed2de68093df41381c6941faf.jpg[/img]

Spectacular Sparky combines an authentic 1990s MegaDrive art style with fast-paced platform/shooter gameplay in a variety of action-packed levels. Stay tuned for more blog posts to learn more about your new favorite video-game mascot! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047987/63505bc1d55d005c4786d03130f18fb073c1056e.png[/img]
